body.name: Exact-support latent feedback class \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal I}(G)\)
body.construction: \(\{(B,(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V}):\operatorname{supp}(B)=E(G),\;\det(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S})\ne0\text{ for every }S\in\mathcal I,\;(P_{\varepsilon_i})_{i\in V}\text{ are mutually independent, nonconstant, and non-Gaussian, and interventions are surgical}\}\).
